info.title: UnoCX AI Service
info.description: Conversational AI for the UnoCX help section. Internal service: called by the UnoCX Next.js app with a service token. See docs/HANDOFF.md.

get.description: Month to date: AI resolutions (for the plan meter), speed, tokens and model cost.

patch.description: Rename, edit content (re-indexed in the background) or switch a source on/off (draft).

post.description: Re-index every source of the workspace (after changing the embedding model, or to refresh websites).
Server-sent events: `meta`, then `delta` (text pieces), then `done` (the full ChatResponse).

get.description: Questions the assistant couldn't answer or that got a thumbs-down: what to write next.

Live quality metrics from real conversations (no expected answers needed).
Shows where the assistant is weak: misses, escalations, low confidence, unsupported numbers,
articles that collect thumbs-down, and the slowest pipeline stage.
Complaints the AI raised for this business's team, newest first.

post.description: Let the AI reply again in a conversation that was handed to a person.

AgentPolicy.title: AgentPolicy
AgentPolicy.description:
Per-workspace configuration sent by the Next.js app with every request. Platform rules
(self-harm care, injection, other customers' data, card/OTP masking, refunds and exchanges
going to a person) are not configurable and always apply.

HandoverPolicy.title: HandoverPolicy
HandoverPolicy.description:
Handover rules the business switches on and tunes in the dashboard (Guardrails tab).
Defaults reproduce the behaviour before policies existed.

serviceToken.description: SERVICE_TOKEN shared with the Next.js app
